_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: log-normal means, ratio exp(0.5)

agreement.claim: both engines report the same estimate, bootstrap SE, percentile and BCa limits, z0 and acceleration
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: 0. harness/trials_examples.test.py checks the shared generator reproduces the C++ standard's minstd_rand check value (399268537 after 10,000 draws from seed 1), rebuilds the percentile limits, and measures coverage over the seeds.

recovery.claim: the estimates are close to the fixture's

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: A first fixture (80 per group, ratio 1.35) could not separate the ratio from 1 (miss 0.38); the fixture uses 150 per group and a ratio of 1.65. Measured by harness/trials_examples.test.py over seeds 0 to 99 (MALLARD_SEEDS=100); CI reruns it on seeds 0 to 49 at the same order statistic.
